summary: Frontend-only verification of the Bottom Navigation (tab bar) safe-area fix. Logged in as test@avision.com and validated tab bar behaviour on 3 viewports (375x667, 390x667, 412x915). All 5 tabs (tab-home, tab-courses, tab-tests, tab-live-class, tab-profile) are rendered inside the viewport (bottom <= window.innerHeight) on every size. tab-current-affairs is correctly hidden. Tab bar is opaque white (rgb(255,255,255)) with position:absolute, borderTopLeftRadius/RightRadius = 20px. FAB (fab-ai-tutor) sits above tab bar (fab_bottom=579, tab_top=606 => no overlap). Tab-to-tab navigation works for all 5 tabs and tab bar stays visible. Bug fix VERIFIED.

issues: On RN Web, iOS shadow / Android elevation on tabBarStyle does not translate to CSS box-shadow (computedStyle.boxShadow = 'none'). Not user-visible on real devices but noted for parity in web preview.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not from the tab-bar fix files, but appears from a dependency / older component in the tree. Reference: repo-wide.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate any lingering pointerEvents={...} usage to style.pointerEvents to silence the RN-Web deprecation warning.
(Optional) If a visible shadow above the tab bar is desired on web preview, add explicit borderTopColor + a tiny inset shadow via a wrapping View; native devices already show elevation correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx correctly uses useSafeAreaInsets() with an Android fallback of 8px and iOS fallback of 16px – good.

index.tsx mirrors the same TAB_BAR_HEIGHT formula (60 + max(insets.bottom, 8/16)) so ScrollView paddingBottom = TAB_BAR_HEIGHT + 40 keeps last card above the bar, and FAB is at TAB_BAR_HEIGHT + 12 so it sits above the bar – good.

Other tab screens (courses, tests, live-class, profile) should apply the same bottom padding pattern to guarantee their own content is not obscured. Only index.tsx was updated in this iteration – recommend a repo-wide check by main agent.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing test user test@avision.com / Test@123 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: on landing screen, tap text 'I already have an account' then use testIDs login-email / login-password / login-submit. After login, the tab bar exposes testIDs tab-home, tab-courses, tab-tests, tab-live-class, tab-profile (tab-current-affairs is hidden via href:null). Playwright bounding_box() returns positions relative to the top of the frame, and window.scrollTo does not scroll RN ScrollView (which uses its own overflow-scroll container). To scroll the home feed programmatically in browser, target the RN ScrollView DOM node (div[data-testid] hierarchy) and set scrollTop instead of using window.scrollTo.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: on Android 3-button nav devices, tab bar was covered because the previous BlurView tab bar used a fixed height and no bottom safe-area inset. Fix: switched to opaque white container, computed BOTTOM_INSET = max(insets.bottom, Platform.OS==='android'?8:16), height = 60 + BOTTOM_INSET, paddingBottom = BOTTOM_INSET. Home screen (index.tsx) applies the same TAB_BAR_HEIGHT to ScrollView paddingBottom (+40) and FAB bottom (+12), preventing content clipping and FAB overlap. All acceptance checks pass in Expo web preview across 375/390/412-wide viewports.
